items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: And he used Onus in Pensacola.

ctx.x: Was it 30? Well, I think so. Mm-hmm. That is, you know, the group of us. I don't think we've gotten away from that style of playing.

The only thing now, I think my style is a slight different because I used to use a lot of wire brushes then. And I used wire brushes then. And I used wire brushes. I used wire brushes. Less now than I used to. Yeah. asked for a lot of wire brushes. The leaders or the dancers? Some of them. The leaders would. That just kept you away from the sticks. But now they're using more sticks now than wire brushes. Wire brushes is used in some numbers because the other night I was asked to use wire brushes on Satan Numbers.…
Gerald Joseph. That's right. And he has Joe Harris on the alto. Alto. And he must be using piano now if he doesn't use it at all. Piano.
